requirement: The system shall provide a web interface for viewing football fixtures, standings, schedules, results, and live scores, and process live score updates through a Kafka streaming pipeline using Apache Avro on EC2.

The system shall use Amazon SageMaker to generate and display machine-learning probabilities for match outcomes such as home win, draw, and away win. For predictions of a season's final week, it shall use current-season match data excluding matches played in that final week.
The system shall recommend nearby venues screening live football matches based on the location or city information supplied by the user.
The system shall provide a text-based chatbot through which users can ask about football fixtures, match results, and nearby match-screening locations and receive relevant conversational responses.

The system shall allow users to request reminders for upcoming fixtures by supplying the match or team context and SMS delivery details, queue the requests through Amazon SQS, and deliver request-based SMS reminders through Amazon SNS.

The system shall host its HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and jQuery web frontend on Amazon S3, use Python and Node for backend logic, and expose AWS Lambda-backed services through Amazon API Gateway for frontend/backend HTTP communication, with JSON as the default data format. The application shall be deployable on the AWS services specified for its hosting, data, notifications, predictions, authentication, and live score processing.
The system shall store football match results, statistics, and fixtures in DynamoDB and use Elasticsearch to support retrieval of the stored match data.
The system shall use Amazon Cognito and IAM for authentication and protected application access, and support AWS Signature Version 4 signing for backend API requests.
